title: Dresden Glaucoma and Treatment Study (DGTS)
official: Dresden Glaucoma and Treatment Study: Analysis to Assure the Quality of Follow-up and Therapy of Glaucoma Patients in a Tertiary University Hospital Glaucoma Service.
summary: To assure the quality of follow-up and treatment, data of glaucoma patients are stored and evaluated after anonymisation.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* manifest glaucoma, ocular Hypertension, glaucoma suspect

Exclusion Criteria:

* under 18 years of age, corneal diseases
